▌ EXECUTIVE SUMMARY 
 
Change & Transformation professional with 12+ years of experience across Financial Services, Investment Banking, Capital Markets and 
Banking Operations, with experience leading business change, adoption and transformation across complex global environments. 
Experienced in change impact assessment, business and market readiness, readiness governance, entry/exit criteria, stakeholder and 
change-network management, training and communications, adoption measurement, go-live readiness and hypercare. Proven ability to 
establish central change frameworks, playbooks, templates and minimum standards while coordinating local business teams, SMEs and 
change champions to drive consistent execution across markets. Strong experience partnering with Business, Operations, Technology, Risk, 
Compliance and senior stakeholders to manage dependencies, RAID, risks, issues and readiness sign-offs. Deep domain experience across 
Investment Banking, Capital Markets, FX Operations, AML/KYC, financial operations and regulatory change.
